overview_description.description:
Anysphere is an artificial intelligence software company that develops Cursor, an AI-powered code editor and software development platform. The company focuses on helping developers write, edit, debug, and manage code through natural language interactions and AI-assisted programming workflows. Rather than offering AI as a plug-in to existing development tools, Anysphere built Cursor as an AI-first development environment that integrates code generation, code understanding, and task automation directly into the editor experience. Its flagship product, Cursor, is based on the Visual Studio Code ecosystem and incorporates large language models to assist with code completion, refactoring, debugging, documentation, and multi-file code changes. The platform can analyze entire codebases, answer context-aware questions, generate new functionality, and automate software development tasks through conversational prompts.

Anysphere also develops AI agents and coding workflows that enable developers to perform complex engineering tasks with reduced manual effort. Its technology integrates with multiple AI models and supports features such as autonomous coding, project-wide code analysis, intelligent code suggestions, and software maintenance workflows. The company's approach combines AI-assisted development with traditional coding tools to support both individual developers and enterprise engineering teams.

about_short_description.short_description: Anysphere is an AI software company that develops AI agents and coding workflows that enable developers to perform engineering tasks.

product.name: Cursor
product.description: An AI-powered code editor that helps developers understand codebases, generate and edit code, autocomplete code, and delegate software-engineering tasks to AI agents.

product.name: Cursor Agent
product.description: An agentic coding service that converts developer instructions into code changes and engineering tasks, using project context and available AI models.

product.name: Cursor CLI
product.description: A command-line interface for using Cursor’s AI coding agents and assistance in terminal-based development workflows.

product.name: Cursor BugBot
product.description: An automated code-review service that examines GitHub pull requests, identifies potential bugs, and suggests fixes or ways to open the change in Cursor.

product.name: Cursor Web Agents
product.description: A web-accessible interface for starting and managing Cursor coding agents remotely, including a mobile agent experience for delegating development tasks.

product.name: Cursor Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise deployment and administration offering for using Cursor across engineering organizations with centralized controls, security features, billing management, and usage insights.
